# dsh-agents-md-editor

A DSH bundle: one left-sidebar entry that opens an editor page for the Agent
instructions file, `~/.

ne left-sidebar entry that opens an editor page for the Agent
instructions file, `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`.

- **Left sidebar entry** — registered in `sidebar.panellist`; the matching
`main` keyed panel is the

page the entry opens.
- **Live** — the page polls the file's sha1 version every 2s. An edit made
el

sewhere (the agent, another editor) appears automatically while the buffer
is clean; with unsaved te

xt it raises a banner instead of overwriting.
- **Safe save** — `POST /agents-md-editor/api/save` ca

rries the version the
page loaded and is refused with `conflict` (409) if the file changed
meanwhile

. Writes go to a temp sibling and are renamed into place, so a
crash never leaves a truncated instru

ctions file.
- **Draft survives panel switches** — switching to the conversation and back
restores u

nsaved text.
- **Follows the host type scale** — every size reads the theme's own variables
(`--dsh-

content-font-size`, `--dsh-content-font-size-secondary`), so
Settings → General → body font size res

izes this page too; no px values are
hardcoded.

nstructions Editor」).
## Configuration

`filePath` (default `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`) is the only file the plugin reads and
writes. `~` and `~/` a

re expanded; a relative value resolves against the Host
process working directory.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Routes

Both routes are gated by `ctx.connection.requestRejection` — the same
browser-trust fence the shippe
d plugins use — and neither accepts a path:
| Route | Method | Body / result |

| `/agents-md-editor/api/state` | GET | `{ exists, path, content, version, mtimeMs, size }` |
| `/ag
ents-md-editor/api/save` | POST | `{ content, baseVersion }` → `{ path, version, mtimeMs, size, save
editor/api/save` | POST | `{ content, baseVersion }` → `{ path, version, mtimeMs, size, savedAt }` |
`version` is the sha1 of the file's UTF-8 bytes.
## Notes

The Host half writes with `node:fs` rather than the file sandbox, because the
target deliberately li

ves outside the session workspace and a UI action has no
approval channel. The route table takes no

user-supplied path, so the reachable
surface is the single configured file.
## Verifying
[代码示例省略，未执行]

22 checks against a throwaway file in the OS temp directory: missing file,
first create, normal save

, stale `baseVersion` → 409 with the file untouched,
405/404/400, the trust fence → 403, and `~` exp

ansion. The real
`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` is never opened.
